messages:
maria_g: heads-up — got a flurry of EU-edge handshake failures at 09:12 UTC, looks correlated with keystore eviction alerts. KMS decrypts fine but downstream certs gone from cache early. digging in, posting samples. cc @aj @sam_k :wave:
aj: pls drop the minimal logs and the keystore event id. are these all on the same proxy pool?
sam_k: recalling we've had TTL normalization jobs running last night — possible drift between rotator TTL and edge cache TTLs. could be race on eviction.
maria_g: yes same proxy pool (eu-proxy-12x). sample log from edge at 09:12: 

```
2026-03-21T09:12:03Z eu-proxy-12x ERROR tls: certificate not found in keystore (alias=svc-prod-eu, event=EVICT_2026-03-21T09:11:58Z)
2026-03-21T09:12:03Z eu-proxy-12x WARN handshake: client hello aborted, fallback to http (client=10.4.2.91)
```

keystore audit event for same time: `audit://keystore/evt-84721` — shows unwrap success at 09:11:59 then `TTL_SET=3600`, but rotator recorded `ttl=7200` in its metadata.
aj: interesting — that mismatch could cause cache to evict earlier if edge TTL comes from rotator metadata or vice-versa. do we have observable source-of-truth for TTL? (rotator writes metadata to s3 + keystore exposes set-ttl)
sam_k: rotator writes `meta/aliases.json` in s3 and keystore returns `expires_at` in keystore API. last night the TTL normalization job updated s3 but failed to patch keystore due to IAM deny (we've got an IAM change in the deploy). looks like partial rollout.
maria_g: so immediate ask: how do we surface this in alerting and audit logs? current alert only says keystore eviction but not the upstream IAM or rotator mismatch. we missed the IAM deny because audit logs are sampled at 1/10 for keystore writes. :grimacing:
aj: two actionable items: 1) increase keystore write-audit sampling for a 12h window; 2) create an SLO alert for large delta between rotator-ttl and keystore-expires (threshold 30% or 300s). both should help detect before client impacts.
sam_k: we'll need an RBAC follow-up — the IAM deny is due to the new role prune that landed yesterday. i'll open a ticket to repro on staging. also we should forward keystore audit events to long-term auditship (ELK -> secure-archive) for forensic.
infra-bot: alertbot: 09:15 UTC — 8 handshake failures (eu-proxy-12x). ticket created: INFRA-2147.
maria_g: thanks. also question for security: do we want the keystore to emit `source_actor` in every TTL set operation? right now it just logs principal id but not deploy tag. would help tie to RBAC changes.
aj: yes, add `source_actor_context` field (deploy-tag, role, request-id) to audit lines. small change in keystore server, low-risk. sam_k can you own?
sam_k: can pick up. timeline: patch keystore audit schema -> smoke -> roll 1% -> full rollback if mismatch. estimate 3-4hrs.
maria_g: for immediate mitigation: re-sync rotator -> keystore TTLs to conservative lower-bound (set both to min of values) and pause TTL normalization job until RBAC is validated. who can approve pause? @aj?
aj: i can approve pause for the 2hr window. do it, post link to rollback doc.
maria_g: done. paused job: https://internal.ops/rotator/jobs/ttl-normalize (paused by aj at 09:40 UTC).
aj: follow-ups: (1) audit sampling bump (2) SLO alert (3) add source_actor_context to keystore audit schema (4) RBAC rollback validation and staging repro (5) ship forensic export of keystore writes for last 48hrs. assign owners and update INFRA-2147.
maria_g: will update ticket with owners and mark high-priority incident review. thanks all. :thumbsup:
aj: also note — add KMS integration check: confirm HSM unwrap latencies didn't exceed threshold around 09:11. low unwrap latency but the issue seems TTL-only. still worth double-checking.
sam_k: will attach KMS unwrap logs and a diff of `meta/aliases.json` vs keystore metadata to the ticket.
maria_g: closing loop here — we'll run a short postmortem tomorrow to capture detection gaps (alerting/audit sampling) and update runbook.
